body:
Pundits, strategists, and special interests will look for any signs of weakness as they plan on where to invest in 2024.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1842%2E4032634%2EyMrG_X)
---
I’ll get right to it: [**If you’re in a place where you can make a contribution to support my re-election campaign today, it will be a huge help.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/994?t=8&akid=1842%2E4032634%2EyMrG_X) Now, you might be wondering why exactly a donation in November 2023 is so important. Let me explain: We’re about to enter a critical election year. The amount that we raise right now will help determine how strong our momentum can be as we start 2024, and how much we can invest in campaigning for our plans. We not only have to spend the next year fighting back against MAGA extremism — but also against a system that benefits from the status quo and says that big change is “impossible.” **That’s why I’m running for re-election — to stop MAGA extremism, build on the progress we’ve made so far, and deliver the big, structural change our country still needs.** I’m talking with people across Massachusetts about the issues affecting their families and campaigning for bold policies that will transform the lives of working people across the country. Policies like creating affordable child care and housing. Holding big corporations accountable and bringing down costs. Reimagining our tax code and passing a wealth tax. But first, we’ve got to win this race. Pundits, strategists, and special interests will look for any signs of weakness as they plan on where to invest in 2024. That’s why it’s incredibly important that we hit all of our grassroots fundraising goals right now so we can run a strong campaign for our plans. [**So before tonight’s end-of-month fundraising deadline, can you please make a contribution of $28 or anything you can to ensure we hit our November 2023 goal and we can prepare to campaign for big, structural change in 2024?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/994?amount=28&t=9&akid=1842%2E4032634%2EyMrG_X)

* Chuck Schumer no longer has to decide where to put his resources–they're coming to Montana. With Joe Manchin out of the race, Schumer will all but write off West Virginia, ceding the seat to Republicans. Manchin's retirement will likely free up between $25-$50 million in defense funds for the Democrats. **[[link to donate]](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e758f8e8339d44b0b12d7fb70a8ee34f&_e=oMgnDAfN84GnkZRVvMRxnKGw3RqU7wB5FoyrwISLLHZmpVE6a_YnrXmQqe3v6DnG6LhSY_A0O_QGBsDr0kYY9O4fZLBd0gDAhtP8qNJoN3SXb5-kk8lrUkLGqfuDjOC8loFbByo9IuSkPk5ipR3EuEPSj5MKeCFXk0awL9SlL9v0yLDpfLHLEw87DL-NCQln67k7GyBVfCttBFekPzXqUmAdDeLSlGegME04z1VlSmzik8-nl_ZOcU-lWVP1r8JizHW6NTNNlHVvqpTXecxm8lgXOWlcOq-WvG8HhPU-azBTLivTg7MPMIt5SB2Ab0e0kSYSOTeYCE2517P8bwUiXxBf1iK-ZGLUOghY-DnXf2P_C8U_FAnRDSJtQGebH7QOVUg0vi176teRZX03CaOl8g4LWR2d-jZFeI-x_QdhivU%3D)**

* Schumer won't have to persuade wealthy coastal donors into donating to a Manchin reelection effort. Instead of choosing between protecting Manchin or Tester - or contributing to both candidates - they'll be donating the maximum amount only to Tester. Coastal donors have helped Tester shatter Montana fundraising records each quarter, accumulating $15 million in donations since January 1st. I need help catching up because, to be frank, we haven't brought in a fraction of this from our online community. [**[link to donate]**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e758f8e8339d44b0b12d7fb70a8ee34f&_e=oMgnDAfN84GnkZRVvMRxnKGw3RqU7wB5FoyrwISLLHZmpVE6a_YnrXmQqe3v6DnG6LhSY_A0O_QGBsDr0kYY9O4fZLBd0gDAhtP8qNJoN3SXb5-kk8lrUkLGqfuDjOC8loFbByo9IuSkPk5ipR3EuEPSj5MKeCFXk0awL9SlL9v0yLDpfLHLEw87DL-NCQln67k7GyBVfCttBFekPzXqUmAdDeLSlGegME04z1VlSmzik8-nl_ZOcU-lWVP1r8Ji3E9R1JYksxUsLvQJPcnmdNb1HnSDPTiMp6D8ZAqvEpSJz60XlTLc_vDSohNFUXUpDH9_8f_lRgB9dE9t0x7S6tMEuw_vG0JPPl_Cm_Z8mGWXFQkoccJS7sCNgGJbetGeuYIZc-xAll56X6CQcL9PuJPNqMFX5wMHa8Nz6rtffgg%3D)

* The other Democrat incumbents up for reelection this year are from states Biden won in 2020. That doesn't necessarily mean Republicans don't have a shot to win these races, but the incumbents aren't as likely to need as much money to win as my opponent will.

Peter,
I’ve always believed that the point of getting elected isn’t to bank political capital. It’s to burn political capital to improve lives.
When Minnesotans elected a one-seat Democratic governing majority last November by a margin of 321 votes, we came together and agreed on two things:
First, our mission was to make Minnesota the best place in the country to live, work, and raise a family. And second, that we would use every ounce of our power to make that vision a reality.
From codifying abortion rights into state law to banning the harmful practice of conversion “therapy” to putting Minnesota on the path to 100% clean energy to enacting common sense gun reforms, we didn’t take a moment for granted.
**I’m damn proud of what we’re doing in our state, but everything we’ve worked to accomplish together could come undone if we fail to defend our DFL trifecta next year.**
In odd years and even years alike, we need your support to hold the line against MAGA Republicans who want to drag us backward. The work can’t stop.
That’s why I’m following up tonight. Our next monthly fundraising deadline is at midnight, and according to the latest update from my fundraising team, we’re still trailing our goal by about $3,000.

Derek, it’s no secret that a lot of people in our country have lost a lot of faith in politics. After all, we’ve seen a lot more dysfunction than results coming from Congress lately – and that’s just something hard-working Pennsylvanians shouldn’t have to put up with. That’s why here in Pennsylvania, we’re showing the country how integrity and bipartisanship in government can help bring real opportunity and real freedom to communities big and small. Whether it’s creating good-paying jobs that don’t require a college degree or supporting our public schools, students, and teachers, I’m proud of all that we’ve accomplished together in just one short year. Working Pennsylvanians don’t want to hear about polls and partisan games from their leaders. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. Lori has been an unwavering advocate for her community, tirelessly working to address the pressing issues that matter most to Americans. She has consistently demonstrated a deep commitment to fiscal responsibility, economic growth, and advocating for the needs of Oregon and America. From championing small businesses to ensuring our veterans receive the care they deserve, she has been a tireless and effective representative for every American. Now, as she embarks on the journey toward re-election, she needs your support more than ever. | Your generous donation will play a crucial role in ensuring that she has the resources needed to reach every voter and continue the great work she has started. Thank you for your support of Congresswoman Lori Chavez-DeRemer. Together, we can ensure that our community continues to have a strong and effective voice in Congress. I am confident that with your support, Lori will secure another term and continue making a positive impact on the lives of those she represents. Thank you, Majority Whip Tom Emmer | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.

Hi friend – Laura here.

I wanted to reach out one last time before I logged off for the night to thank you for being with us from the start.
We need leaders in Washington with a proven track record of getting things done for, and with, their community. Your support is key to building a strong base of grassroots support to win this campaign.
Our finance team has been tracking our fundraising numbers, and as of now, we have about $2,347 left to raise before midnight to hit our end-of-month goal. Can I count on you to use this link to give $5 and help us make up ground?

**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lf-q4-2023?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74346960/441380861/-1415976427?refcode=em-11.31.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDFjMTQ0MmMtZWE4Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wZNep8KCjfYDkP8_MX2n4w5DpNkooiQ6vx-Md2tY6KA=)**

I don’t love asking for money, but ever since the _Citizens United_ decision, elections have become more expensive and candidate fundraising has become more vital. As it stands today, this race looks set to be one of the most expensive in the nation. And unlike others in this race, I’m counting on individual donors rather than giant corporations.

Each individual donation sends a message that our community is ready for home-grown, progressive change in Washington. To me, that is much more powerful, and it's why I value your support. I’d appreciate anything you can give to help us meet this goal before November comes to a close.

I’m so proud to be running a corporate PAC-free campaign, but that means we’re reliant on the support we get from emails like this one. Anything you can afford to chip in will go a long way.

Here’s the link to chip in again: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lf-q4-2023?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74346961/441380862/-1415976427?refcode=em-11.31.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDFjMTQ0MmMtZWE4Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wZNep8KCjfYDkP8_MX2n4w5DpNkooiQ6vx-Md2tY6KA=)**

Laura

Peter, I needed to reach out one last time before our November deadline passes us by.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | [Unsubscribe](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_s=2ac53672368f4907a68acd72e5435154&_t=y6986RnuLWEquK_namXidxjcp54CFp5snPkdpgKv9UK2Hb3_eLwJX89-kdyKsVoHzbXh_YpOry0UAnKyraRqtDUQM69KpmLMD5uk800abpE%3D) | [Mark as Junk](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_s=2ac53672368f4907a68acd72e5435154&_t=y6986RnuLWEquK_namXidxjcp54CFp5snPkdpgKv9UK2Hb3_eLwJX89-kdyKsVoHzbXh_YpOry0UAnKyraRqtDUQM69KpmLMD5uk800abpE%3D)

Peter,

I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2ac53672368f4907a68acd72e5435154&_e=Ch_wUudezruIxBrNjSr54Up7BKTe3zkfVDn5KKw7WEp26fgif2eSJycibZ0E4we8x_h1drd0ewBUXb8kVoazvt6hLSh62p9qYAz63jJ98Y-uOR7EB8LhxvS-Rc9cmgJZnyhPNeLZuGX5fX0MOnxbeZZ2n9WJSzyC9eR5sTqXMZ7RMoeUb3xEumz2lRz0L9FKwtyrmxKpRsrOo39DkSipTuXjqqw4eiGCKacgSh3e3wIAbAAaWdCFyRqm_zByd1S4TbBmorOiP3XbpjoyoNhbZzvfvqkQ42FRuqQa2Xk791kkrtPnHmz2c_wW2_oaiiXTQKPrRQ2rnrQRdbZXZjE11LXVMNQt5riG_ouTlOQxXkPPJNbpxFIVjRE3hmFz5TEo1TJdbzuvNneQpi_9tzLtXqx753y_kCerU6ybDecCA_o%3D)**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2ac53672368f4907a68acd72e5435154&_e=Ch_wUudezruIxBrNjSr54Up7BKTe3zkfVDn5KKw7WEp26fgif2eSJycibZ0E4we8x_h1drd0ewBUXb8kVoazvt6hLSh62p9qYAz63jJ98Y-uOR7EB8LhxvS-Rc9cmgJZnyhPNeLZuGX5fX0MOnxbeZZ2n9WJSzyC9eR5sTqXMZ7RMoeUb3xEumz2lRz0L9FKwtyrmxKpRsrOo39DkSipTuXjqqw4eiGCKacgSh3e3wIAbAAaWdCFyRqm_zByd1S4sZNO-oSOnDY46950ZyiUbczssLd8fI6jrnQj8xjkNq2furCmUeYQA1UCVDfaQ2pwK0aAJRyS_Df982ne6EtpAuD8P3InPnKsKgxUDA-C2LFTVEwV2XQ0IyHl6ao30AF-x4M5pRGgS5byf9Xcs2RXWGlGPQ914u9iCEjWJkbVcm8%3D)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

---
| | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2ac53672368f4907a68acd72e5435154&_e=Ch_wUudezruIxBrNjSr54Up7BKTe3zkfVDn5KKw7WEp26fgif2eSJycibZ0E4we8x_h1drd0ewBUXb8kVoazvt6hLSh62p9qYAz63jJ98Y-uOR7EB8LhxvS-Rc9cmgJZnyhPNeLZuGX5fX0MOnxbeZZ2n9WJSzyC9eR5sTqXMZ7RMoeUb3xEumz2lRz0L9FKwtyrmxKpRsrOo39DkSipTuXjqqw4eiGCKacgSh3e3wIAbAAaWdCFyRqm_zByd1S4sCKwyIMWRa1QT3lqJQKdZMN4_yuS618Goay5n1Lpdx-0q1gluZ-IFh5UD4B5gveJ9OOlipEXLU_4ZN_dn25OqqAQBU_cCqF4Va9PK8KYbxz-d9an_tvxpYHwv0SVrXcIsRwNOaKXty4ZvWBD8B8AlCgQzKCRNTHRNdug-mgT9io%3D)
---
When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2ac53672368f4907a68acd72e5435154&_e=Ch_wUudezruIxBrNjSr54Up7BKTe3zkfVDn5KKw7WEp26fgif2eSJycibZ0E4we8x_h1drd0ewBUXb8kVoazvt6hLSh62p9qYAz63jJ98Y-uOR7EB8LhxvS-Rc9cmgJZnyhPNeLZuGX5fX0MOnxbeZZ2n9WJSzyC9eR5sTqXMZ7RMoeUb3xEumz2lRz0L9FKwtyrmxKpRsrOo39DkSipTuXjqqw4eiGCKacgSh3e3wIAbAAaWdCFyRqm_zByd1S4DchznvLnfDdLxx-5smBowPH50-aUhsFViD-AanPWMCVNXmu416s-IR17ImMrBz7qilTq61ku66E4gj4HnJkoOFXHsO8Dk6mp5P6SaSFeNem5JTzBK7xKTxOZsdV6hBAShT1Y6gGuV8WcR9tDGEliYK2tZ5yPKEtTdpMvbxqblH0%3D)

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36249%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NNSMemD3ciObDWZ2b9h2qQ&sysid=1)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids. Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they think they are still big and ugly. However, Marco and Paul wanted to change this perception with a **revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers formerly from Siemens.**

But now, a **game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry** , and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they’ve seen in over a decade.

It’s called **Horizon by hear.com.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time--when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **Horizon has taken the U.S. by storm since its release in early 2023** , offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36240%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vyLEjTD3PWDJv7qXPZKMYA&sysid=1)
[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36249%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NNSMemD3ciObDWZ2b9h2qQ&sysid=1)
What makes Horizon so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

With Horizon, they can. **Imagine effortless hearing in every situation** --restaurants, weddings, block parties, and beyond. Imagine being able to **understand every word clearly** with a device so small and comfortable, you’ll completely forget you’re wearing it.

This means that Horizon offers all of the usual benefits of a modern hearing aid--from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming--with the added bonus of something completely new: it can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It’s not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It’s about speech clarity. And that’s precisely what Horizon is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity --and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/christmas-carol](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1983hfkrq30v4j8v8u12bmhbelngbchqsjdudsg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c5h61ob2chh2bs)**

body:
This powerful secret weapon against hearing loss is crushing the market

| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9e4r6t0dv488phhbej2lkogr89ei93qt84eb15o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c5h61ob4s9h2bs)

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids. Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they think they are still big and ugly. However, Marco and Paul wanted to change this perception with a **revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers formerly from Siemens.**

But now, a **game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry** , and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's called **Horizon by hear.com.**

And it's the perfect solution at the perfect time--when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It's no wonder **Horizon has taken the U.S. by storm since its release in early 2023** , offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zv21cpeekffse1mespk0ipnhaaqvvbl1tv9ct7gg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c5h61ob4s9h2bs)
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zttjlu8og98r9tbreqt1e58k3koiaoa2bqaidrjg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c5h61ob4s9h2bs)

Dear Fellow Patriot,

Tired? Frustrated? Angry? Believe me, I get it. So am I.

Every day, I watch the news, and I think, 'This can't be happening. This isn't the America I know. It's not the America that stands as a beacon of freedom and opportunity to the rest of the world.'

Our institutions, the ones that should be the bedrock of our society, are failing. Our children — the future leaders of our great nation — are being filled with lies about the history of our great country.

It's sobering, to say the least. Yet, in all of this dismay, I find a glimmer of hope. That hope is supporters like you—[supporters of The Heritage Foundation.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

At The Heritage Foundation, we’re fighting for the principles that make this nation a shining city on a hill. Our Constitution, and the values it enshrines, are the lifeblood of our country. They have weathered storms before, and we will ensure they weather this one.

**But we can't do it without you.** Your voice, your opinions, they matter. They are vital in times like these. That's why we need your help.

We're conducting a survey about America's current leadership. This is a rally for those who still believe in the American Dream and the traditional values that underpin it all. This is your chance to be heard, to effect real change. To speak for American values of freedom, opportunity, and principled leadership.

So, are you with me? Will you take the survey and make your voice heard?

[Yes, I Want To Speak Up Now »](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-ToLyfVFqwswJDvl96cfsg)

I'm grateful for your time and, most importantly, for your enduring commitment to America and our values. Together, we can make a difference.

Sincerely,

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.
President, The Heritage Foundation

So-called “experts” told me not to raise the issue of gun safety reform in Georgia, but I knew my community better. **I’ve become a leading voice on gun violence prevention in Congress, but a recent court ruling has put my reelection into question.** Republicans in the state legislature are redrawing Congressional maps and I need to be ready for any outcome. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Congress of Counties_**
---
Friends, IT'S HERE! We are excited to announce that early-bird registration is officially open for our [Congress of Counties](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/63a1a33042f640d43947229f28c3afba/dcf28d859e375fd8c3d6b838967d376c/40313) event, which will be held on February 23rd and 24th in downtown Indianapolis! This two day event is an opportunity for Hoosier Republicans at every level to come together to network and develop skills in party building and grassroots campaigning. At Congress of Counties, we plan to have something for everyone. Whether you are a county chair with 40 years of experience or a newly enthused activist who wants to get involved, we have something for you. From training seminars, to networking, to fellowship and fun, this is a weekend you won't want to miss. We will prepare you at Congress of Counties to make the difference you want to make in your community, and we will get you connected with the right people! We will help you grow within the party. Register [HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/63a1a33042f640d43947229f28c3afba/88102b6f5cf063aac3d6b838967d376c/40313) as soon as possible to take advantage of the early bird-rate. The early-bird rate is available until December 31st. Let's work together to build our party up from the grassroots and make our communities better places to live, through a strong Republican Party!
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# _Gov. Holcomb Appointed Our State's Next Comptroller, Elise Nieshalla_
---
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/63a1a33042f640d43947229f28c3afba/4bd9ae80f90d67e8c3d6b838967d376c/40313)**Governor Eric Holcomb** appointed Elise Nieshalla to serve as Indiana's next State Comptroller. Elise Nieshalla serves as the president of the Indiana County Councils Association (ICCA), president of the Boone County Council and is the chairwoman of the Association of Indiana Counties’ 2023 Legislative Committee. Additionally, Nieshalla was one of the founding members of the Hoosier Leadership Series and was tasked with overseeing education and tax policy for the program. She is a graduate of the Richard G. Lugar Excellence in Public Service Series and was named 2018 Indiana County Councilor of the Year. **What he’s saying** : “Elise is a dedicated and proven public servant who has committed much of her professional life to bettering her community through service... She has shared her financial expertise to help steer and shape the bright future of Boone County which gives me great confidence she’ll do the same serving Hoosiers as our next State Comptroller”, **Gov. Holcomb** shared in a press release. **What else happened this week? Gov. Holcomb** and Imagine Indiana announced the launch of [All Around Indiana](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/63a1a33042f640d43947229f28c3afba/00e10296669bedb1c3d6b838967d376c/40313), a one-stop shop for videos that tell the Hoosier story in a vibrant and unique way.

Giving machines are used for people to donate to national charities. While out shopping for Christmas, Hoosiers can stop by these machines and make a donation. "The Giving Machines will benefit thousands of Hoosiers. And it not just benefits those who receive the gifts from the machine, but it benefits those of us who are giving", said Lt. Gov. Crouch

Police Officer
_ [**➡ YES! I Want to Protect My Family Today With Life-Saving Solar Power!**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=072a53c51dbd447281bc4575673a5710&_e=EQ9MO5o4-WRvLP5ptatree2VFfeHaX-lA6H77MYevPNa05jKyXJwJsE265BwVm7D9SyGC9a3G_iRqaYj-1DgMEa_f5PL8EOHf_A0cx5y6fDilOm3_79FDHPq2_x9EjYWSPuP_kvHnyYdHmLfs8Ne2iAxLR5vbWio353PhgggGdMbesAtcbtrxVshKIQNFyrSioPxXbLgqAnhFcunHo8kImxo6rPprDcnegEb_gwfOUY0z-pszbAuCpuBmVy5JmGw-y7SsV90ItnYLH1hqYVywYigqON3s7uw1dTDc9oFYjtRnyF7zUyCo5MICjIJszd1) **More Raving Reviews From Customers** | | **Rita L.** This product is so versatile, and at only 8 lbs, my grandchildren can get it. We had many trees down from a storm. The guys kept having to refill their gas powered chainsaws. My husband came out with this "little" box and his electric chainsaw. They laughed and said a long electric cord would be too dangerous. My husband calmly hooked up his Sidekick and made short work at lopping off the branches and then walked through the path he made. It lasted longer than the gas 'polluting' machines. Very grateful you have made this available to buy at an affordable price.
---|---
| **Steve G.** Peace of mind for years. I purchased this product to provide power to run a box fan in the summer and lights in the winter. I can use this product every day for over four years as it can be recharged up to 2,000 times. It won't make noise that draws attention and can create comfort in a difficult situation. Best of all, it's portable.
---|---
| **Thomas B.** Saved my CPAP machine during the winter storms. I just survived the ice storm, the freeze and the power outage in Texas using my 4Patriots products. I was most happy about my Patriot Power Sidekick. It's quiet. It's clean. I was able to deploy the solar panels on the dashboard of my van, it charged up. And then that night I plugged in my CPAP machine and it ran it all night long. With enough to charge my phone in the morning.
---|---
| **Jana H.** Portable power was a blessing when the grid failed us. I didn't think I'd need this but I needed it shortly after receiving it. This past February was the worst freeze that we, in Texas, have seen in a long time. Our power grid failed big time. We were without power for a couple of days. This product was a blessing. We were able to have a light and a small portable TV. I highly recommend this product and the company that sells it.
---|---
| **Allan D.** Patriot Power Sidekick to the rescue. We brought our new Patriot Power Sidekick with us on our last camping trip and it was a blessing. Our primary use was to power an air pump to easily fill up our air mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. One night we had a pinhole leak in the air mattress, so we just kept the Sidekick inside the tent hooked up to the air pump and ran it for a few minutes about every 3 hours to keep it fully inflated. It's quiet and powerful, and we will have it with us on every camping trip!
---|---
| **Chris S.** Power out, no problem. Recently had a power outage due to some crazy storms. I use my phone for everything. Having the sidekick charged up and charging my nearly dead phone meant I was able to have my alarm and get to work on time. Thank you for this compact, lightweight and fume free portable charging/light station available for when I needed it the most!
---|---
| **Richard B.** Well worth it! This is one of the items that made me a loyal customer. I never was a big fan on solar-powered anything. At the same time I've been in enough situations to know any type of a generator is necessary when you live in a more rural setting. Especially when gas prices go through the roof. I purchased the Sidekick and as soon as it arrived I unpacked it and plugged it into a lamp and left it plugged in all evening. I was impressed how little it took from the battery! After 3 hours the Sidekick was still at 98% fully charged. I'm looking forward to having two Sidekicks!
---|---
| **Frank S.** We have been looking for quite a while for something like this. The deal with the solar panels included was something not to pass up! We both have sleep apnea and use c/bipap machines for sleep. The power went out recently and the sidekick worked great. As a test we ran the Sidekick on the humidifier and it ran about 7 hours! It's a small humidifier. That's not bad for that type of application. Cannot wait till camping season comes along! We highly recommend this product.
---|---

And you can use it right inside your home, because it's fume-free and SAFE. You can't say that about a typical generator. Not by a long shot. So you can have the ultimate peace of mind that you and your family will stay connected when disaster strikes. Silent, Fume-FREE & Safe Fast Recharge Long-Lasting Battery Recharge 2,000 Times! Easy to Use Completely Portable & Easy to Use! Powers Your Favorite Devices FREE Portable 40-Watt Solar Panel Included and more! That's why it's our privilege to introduce to you: "I really like how many things the Sidekick can run. I can charge my cell phone and iPad at the same time, run an electric razor, my radio, an electric blanket and so much more. It's so easy to take with you anywhere - very light!" Craig W. Police Officer More Raving Reviews From Customers | | Rita L. This product is so versatile, and at only 8 lbs, my grandchildren can get it. We had many trees down from a storm. The guys kept having to refill their gas powered chainsaws. My husband came out with this "little" box and his electric chainsaw. They laughed and said a long electric cord would be too dangerous. My husband calmly hooked up his Sidekick and made short work at lopping off the branches and then walked through the path he made. It lasted longer than the gas 'polluting' machines. Very grateful you have made this available to buy at an affordable price. ---|--- | Steve G. Peace of mind for years. I purchased this product to provide power to run a box fan in the summer and lights in the winter. I can use this product every day for over four years as it can be recharged up to 2,000 times. It won't make noise that draws attention and can create comfort in a difficult situation. Best of all, it's portable. ---|--- | Thomas B. Saved my CPAP machine during the winter storms. I just survived the ice storm, the freeze and the power outage in Texas using my 4Patriots products. I was most happy about my Patriot Power Sidekick. It's quiet. It's clean. I was able to deploy the solar panels on the dashboard of my van, it charged up. And then that night I plugged in my CPAP machine and it ran it all night long. With enough to charge my phone in the morning. ---|--- | Jana H. Portable power was a blessing when the grid failed us. I didn't think I'd need this but I needed it shortly after receiving it. This past February was the worst freeze that we, in Texas, have seen in a long time. Our power grid failed big time. We were without power for a couple of days. This product was a blessing. We were able to have a light and a small portable TV. I highly recommend this product and the company that sells it. ---|--- | Allan D. Patriot Power Sidekick to the rescue. We brought our new Patriot Power Sidekick with us on our last camping trip and it was a blessing. Our primary use was to power an air pump to easily fill up our air mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. One night we had a pinhole leak in the air mattress, so we just kept the Sidekick inside the tent hooked up to the air pump and ran it for a few minutes about every 3 hours to keep it fully inflated. It's quiet and powerful, and we will have it with us on every camping trip! ---|--- | Chris S. Power out, no problem. Recently had a power outage due to some crazy storms. I use my phone for everything. Having the sidekick charged up and charging my nearly dead phone meant I was able to have my alarm and get to work on time. Thank you for this compact, lightweight and fume free portable charging/light station available for when I needed it the most! ---|--- | Richard B. Well worth it! This is one of the items that made me a loyal customer. I never was a big fan on solar-powered anything. At the same time I've been in enough situations to know any type of a generator is necessary when you live in a more rural setting. Especially when gas prices go through the roof. I purchased the Sidekick and as soon as it arrived I unpacked it and plugged it into a lamp and left it plugged in all evening. I was impressed how little it took from the battery! After 3 hours the Sidekick was still at 98% fully charged. I'm looking forward to having two Sidekicks! ---|--- | Frank S.** We have been looking for quite a while for something like this. The deal with the solar panels included was something not to pass up! We both have sleep apnea and use c/bipap machines for sleep. The power went out recently and the sidekick worked great. As a test we ran the Sidekick on the humidifier and it ran about 7 hours! It's a small humidifier. That's not bad for that type of application. Cannot wait till camping season comes along! We highly recommend this product. ---|--- Defend the Constitution 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 | _

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Tell President Biden to expand National Monument in California
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Tell President Biden to PROTECT the San Gabriel Mountains in California! >> [_Take action now!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2166924?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** What does stepping out into nature after a long day stuffed inside do for you? When I get that breath of fresh air, I’m reinvigorated. It clears my head of all the noise of daily life, and for a moment, I find peace. Imagine not having access to that comfort -- stuck in a **concrete grid of honking cars with pollution-spitting tail pipes.** For many communities, green spaces are few and far between. The San Gabriel Mountains make up _**70% of Los Angeles county’s open space.**_ It’s a popular refuge from the bustle of city life, a source of drinking water, and culturally significant to Indigenous people. **But large swaths of this critical green space are still UNPROTECTED from developers!** [_**Please, Friend, urge President Biden to expand the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument to safeguard public lands!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2166925?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ***9,312 More Signatures Needed*** | [Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2166926?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
More than **18 million people** live within 90 miles of the San Gabriel Mountains. And the areas surrounding the mountains are largely urban and culturally diverse communities. As a sprawling city, you can walk and walk all day without finding your way out. That’s why spaces like the San Gabriel Mountains are so important.
The proposed monument expansion would encompass more of the Angeles National Forest, which provides **one-third of the county’s drinking water!** Anywhere with this many people relying on it for a life-sustaining resource like water must be protected. [_**Friend, please protect the San Gabriel Mountains and send your message to President Biden by 11:59pm TONIGHT!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2166927?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2166926?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Standing with you,
Raena Garcia
Senior Fossil Fuel and Lands Campaigner,
Friends of the Earth**

## Anti-Aging Drug for Dogs Enters Testing
A new anti-aging drug for dogs [has won approval](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1ytCAUQJ8Gu-vAxR8oLL7Gbr82pcPCVckgOMBq8vaZTZ3uFKc4cz4ey8P44OP23xw01TUtxlZ_0SIQBKBcusZNKxGSbGgSIxed1N2AzT6tSj-tseT6fkD1dFqjdaofubDPfuxU4yfkKAVyIXiv5dAqzZUWg8Be991KhnWcnK8pt5_Jx7rTGr7TRbm16WjCtNd6Fib_MZwZzvd9t-XwdS8pehMPs701hnM5TK4Q6S4MZ_MGcPm1Qd1NBZtewQF9VYoOXNoKBH9RAR_tTgVsSIUy1ATmPHO6TAChuFZSSsFwbvLkztuH4Mswso5vh_Hht67--eonAAD__5h0a8o) from the Food and Drug Administration to begin clinical trials, marking the first time the FDA has shown a willingness to consider a longevity drug of any kind. The new drug, called LOY-001, is an injection for dogs over seven years old and 40 pounds that would be given every three to six months. The goal is to add at least [a year of life to larger dogs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvgc5oZmxjXLh4Dd2-NiXyrgeYyOAVOIv276OkTn2Lq_Nxm25RsuzL_7hxqHOZ4qPKiyckhYr0ZNoUZmZi3XJAB2i0Nz21a7ADWT04D_ae0JiYtEN_T4NO3hE410ogII0EiGC97rvBw-CxR7LempljY4CT1HJ0n0X2uvKc3-XFR_coW5vDWuvzbPS_hsaGxuu6undcS_mpDY1ZZj7rO3NDY9yrqLjIvqh0fC0qleVUz6NscvKpwAICDg66tW65PUJ6XpKznL1rDCxblPx7rH_6vwMAAP__tFBaXA), who typically die younger than small dogs. The company behind it, Loyal for Dogs, says if the drug proves effective in a series of trials, it could be on the market by 2026 at a cost under $100 a month. The FDA approval also gives hope to other companies pursuing longevity drugs for dogs and humans.

| |
Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. body:
Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: A Christmas Carol.

| | | This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c79eccd8309f49d883994e1b2c92752f&_e=HLZvB_-yoGAeRgTdVVzhESkF-fG-TEtGmfRM2KbkMTdQbOnLtIOJ8xIZyPTj7cvtET41oFRlNjA7tDlhWCimUjopnKY8S4vsrCxsHCDw%3D%3D)

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/christmas-carol](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c79eccd8309f49d883994e1b2c92752f&_e=HLZvB_XUp0HxWb4aYKgkOjFuzC5oD8iiRI6x2IXdGvspXe1QIsi0Sk7DaNeWqrL91eqtUSUXtjTHfG6EEZw0xYR0PLCi03XpVw2tjzFBBjuhoP5pGWlyEVx360kDu5Lq2O0BeGyJGyba4V5sXuZm3TTJvtPlg7OSMY55RM3Q5KvnS91S6Y4zpKVzLDv6crenkU1WS8KQW0kwVu6qHIieZaH0LNAYsAhArs8jiC8CeK74lpGWYr3Gr0trb5BMvWrWKOxmbPrWk8Irs6wU7h6argytEBESmSluF6EjMkm2k1C_XfgW5tit10vOzLdG1CUFy1F5XmsBR13dyWV7jO7pl9FHrRcNMaqll798xn__EpNFTl2N_VvOYqi-lSntHZAE-xcZJayr1etMpqf55_JOCQ%3D%3D)**

Let your family and friends know of this free online course as well. We hope it will add meaning and joy to your Christmas celebrations.

Best regards,

Larry P. Arnn

| President Biden straight up lies that Republicans want to cut Social Security and Medicare. Here's a simple fact: these programs are headed towards insolvency, and are not fiscally sustainable. The irony is that by doing nothing to reform Social Security and Medicare, we effectively cut these programs. Both of these programs are funded via Trust Funds. That's a fancy way of saying that payroll taxes (from everyone's paycheck) and other income are deposited in a U.S. Treasury fund to pay for benefits and administration. Even Medicare's own Board of Trustees is very clear that Medicare Part A will be depleted by 2031. And the Social Security Administration's Board of Trustees projects that the Social Security Trust Fund will be depleted by 2035. In Medicare, the depletion of the trust fund means an automatic 11% cut. For Social Security, it's an automatic 23% cut.
President Biden is waiting for these programs to implode and chastising the next generation of legislators for giving a damn about fiscal responsibility and the future of our country. We can't let that happen.

| There are a couple of implications of recent data surrounding abortion following the overturning of Roe v. Wade, but the most important one is the most obvious: Restricting abortion saves lives.
The left will argue that restricting abortions did not generate the surge in births that one might expect.
But that leads us to the second implication, which is that maybe people act more responsibly when they believe their actions have actual consequences? Perhaps behaviors are changing that negate the option of abortion altogether.
Abortion used to be seen as a "rare" option. In fact, even Democrats used to say that abortion should be "safe, legal, and rare". But the left has evolved into a totally different mindset on this issue, in which abortion is normalized and even celebrated as an option to terminate inconvenient pregnancies. That is awful and it needs to change.
Slowly but surely, we must reverse that mindset. People need to acknowledge what they already know: the unborn child inside of them is a person.

| Recent reporting from Fox News and Bill Melugin from the southern border is shocking: at least 21 child sex predators have been arrested crossing illegally into our country since October.
These are child rapists, sodomists, and abusers that have been arrested trying to enter our country illegally.
And this reporting leads us to an obvious question: how many of these monsters weren't caught?
The truth is we will never know, because Joe Biden has created a situation in which we have virtually no control of our southern border. We have no idea who is trying to enter our country and who is currently inside of our borders after crossing illegally into America.
This is a historic dereliction of duty by Joe Biden.
The reality is that securing our southern border is not difficult. It does not require throwing money at the problem or radical policy solutions.
In fact, all it requires is ENFORCING THE LAWS ALREADY ON THE BOOKS.
We must enforce the immigration laws passed by Congress to prevent people from coming into our country illegally and deport those who we know are here illegally. We also must end the abuses in our asylum laws that incentivize illegal immigration and bogus asylum claims.
If we enforce the most basic policies that are already in place, we will make real progress in securing our border and stopping dangerous people from coming into our country.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | == | Peter – This week I debunked the lies President Biden continues to regurgitate about Republicans wanting to cut Social Security and Medicare. I also analyzed what recent data on abortion tells us about protecting the lives of the unborn and highlighted the continued dereliction of duty from President Biden at our southern border. As always, your support is critical as I fight for you on the issues that matter most in Congress. As I am gearing up for my re-election campaign here in Texas, I would greatly appreciate any donation you can provide. My campaign is impossible without the generosity of patriots like you from across the country and I am grateful for your continued support. | | | == | Now, here's your campaign brief: | | | | | | | | BIDEN CONTINUES TO LIE ABOUT SOCIAL SECURITY AND MEDICARE | | == | | | President Biden straight up lies that Republicans want to cut Social Security and Medicare. Here's a simple fact: these programs are headed towards insolvency, and are not fiscally sustainable. The irony is that by doing nothing to reform Social Security and Medicare, we effectively cut these programs. Both of these programs are funded via Trust Funds. That's a fancy way of saying that payroll taxes (from everyone's paycheck) and other income are deposited in a U.S. Treasury fund to pay for benefits and administration. Even Medicare's own Board of Trustees is very clear that Medicare Part A will be depleted by 2031. And the Social Security Administration's Board of Trustees projects that the Social Security Trust Fund will be depleted by 2035. In Medicare, the depletion of the trust fund means an automatic 11% cut. For Social Security, it's an automatic 23% cut. President Biden is waiting for these programs to implode and chastising the next generation of legislators for giving a damn about fiscal responsibility and the future of our country. We can't let that happen. | | | | | | | | WHAT NEW ABORTION DATA TELLS US ABOUT PROTECTING LIFE | == | == | There are a couple of implications of recent data surrounding abortion following the overturning of Roe v. Wade, but the most important one is the most obvious: Restricting abortion saves lives. The left will argue that restricting abortions did not generate the surge in births that one might expect. But that leads us to the second implication, which is that maybe people act more responsibly when they believe their actions have actual consequences? Perhaps behaviors are changing that negate the option of abortion altogether. Abortion used to be seen as a "rare" option. In fact, even Democrats used to say that abortion should be "safe, legal, and rare". But the left has evolved into a totally different mindset on this issue, in which abortion is normalized and even celebrated as an option to terminate inconvenient pregnancies. That is awful and it needs to change. Slowly but surely, we must reverse that mindset. People need to acknowledge what they already know: the unborn child inside of them is a person. | | | | | | BIDEN'S DERELICTION OF DUTY AT OUR BORDER | == | == | Recent reporting from Fox News and Bill Melugin from the southern border is shocking: at least 21 child sex predators have been arrested crossing illegally into our country since October. These are child rapists, sodomists, and abusers that have been arrested trying to enter our country illegally. And this reporting leads us to an obvious question: how many of these monsters weren't caught? The truth is we will never know, because Joe Biden has created a situation in which we have virtually no control of our southern border. We have no idea who is trying to enter our country and who is currently inside of our borders after crossing illegally into America. This is a historic dereliction of duty by Joe Biden. The reality is that securing our southern border is not difficult. It does not require throwing money at the problem or radical policy solutions. In fact, all it requires is ENFORCING THE LAWS ALREADY ON THE BOOKS. We must enforce the immigration laws passed by Congress to prevent people from coming into our country illegally and deport those who we know are here illegally. We also must end the abuses in our asylum laws that incentivize illegal immigration and bogus asylum claims. If we enforce the most basic policies that are already in place, we will make real progress in securing our border and stopping dangerous people from coming into our country. | | | | | | | | == | | | == | My custom eyepatch is back in stock - with options for left or right eye. name: Team Moore Updates
subject: The start of the service year program
body:
Friend, it’s official: the Service Year Option is now live!

This first-in-the-nation Public Service Year Program for recent high school graduates has now officially kicked off. The first cohort will work with local non-profits, businesses, public agencies, and schools to help recent high school graduates kickstart their careers in public service.

We’re so proud to kick off this important program right here in Maryland. Maryland will continue to lead the way in promoting service — and with your support right now, we can expand on the groundwork we’ve established in the first year of Wes’ governorship. Will you contribute right now so we can expand our work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231201-1?refcode=em20231201]

This program is a really big deal. By investing in our youth, we’re investing in a whole new generation for our future. Service is what will bring us together — and we can’t stop here.

This program will create new pathways for service to meet the needs of the community, promote preparedness, and prepare the new cohort for other paths of education, whether that’s higher education or vocational training.

As the participants complete the service year, we’re hoping this will inspire more folks across the state to join our vision of service and go back to their communities to serve.

Wes’ vision for service will serve as an inspiration for Marylanders and other states in the country to strengthen their commitment to service. Support Wes’ vision by making a contribution right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231201-1?refcode=em20231201]

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through for Wes Moore immediately:
Donate $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231201-1?refcode=em20231201&express_lane=true&amount=10]
Donate $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231201-1?refcode=em20231201&express_lane=true&amount=25]

As always, thank you for your support.
Team Moore

I’ll be voting shortly and will keep you in the loop,
Josh

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

| From Siskiyou to San Diego, we’re building our team bigger and stronger to win this U.S. Senate race. And today, we’re asking you to step up as a member of the team that is going to do it.

Remember, D.C. statehood isn't just a political maneuver; it's a constitutional issue. Walter E. Washington, D.C.'s first elected home rule mayor, warned that separating the city into a state would erode its very fabric. The district-as-a-state would lack critical industries and amenities, making it reliant on other states or the federal government – a situation unique among states.
Opposition to this idea isn't rooted in racism, as the Democrats would have you believe. __It's based on practical, historical, and constitutional grounds.__ The Justice Department has clearly stated: "Statehood for the District of Columbia is not a racial issue. It is not a civil rights issue. It is a constitutional issue that goes to the very foundation of our federal union."
So, let's stand together, as proud Americans, to **[uphold the vision of our Founders and protect the integrity of our nation.](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYoX9ls6uHz6nseaLc9yeOc5gJTrfTj8QMzrK5BHQBzw9MolcZcX6EfsOG_D_GoPGpHitCUIS1QjnKA3w5beIGuG4Rb5m28Gl1_zu4ZG2OLfbo6GwNDP89b3GAe_2h_N4p84cZRe9T97FH3K8Lp7eObFGFg7vIDnKBogTOcDGjlPf63RTqpIM-qUm9kmHNy2RDzig7AsHMG8z7Pum56cESVupjkFAK9dIuOwZgxCMhZgMn9bC_bzrq7njMjW5L4GRWwPdNXJoJ4WysocYHetu9Ip8pnaN4K1arNn69ufs5fk9GLrpKtI73-LVJRpQVsVYjS1xi87dEDddfF0xSVTzSQYcp6FtzyiFJzGbZ5LbkKPggFGchDcm5Wh1QqSVpaTNvvOepvFzxaIRca1eZn61bAearFG7hZBNQ-8pZOnSN9-t&e=f30dc52ea6b3f0fa359c0052b3984e35&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231128_hd_urgent_help_25_777&n=6)** **[Add your name immediately to our petition and be counted among those who cherish our Constitution and our Union.](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYoX9ls6uHz6nseaLc9yeOc5gJTrfTj8QMzrK5BHQBzw9MolcZcX6EfsOG_D_GoPGpHitCUIS1QjnKA3w5beIGuG4Rb5m28Gl1_zu4ZG2OLfbo6GwNDP89b3GAe_2h_N4p84cZRe9T97FH3K8Lp7eObFGFg7vIDnKBogTOcDGjlPf63RTqpIM-qUm9kmHNy2RDzig7AsHMG8z7Pum56cESVupjkFAK9dIuOwZgxCMhZgMn9bC_bzrq7njMjW5L4GRWwPdNXJoJ4WysocYHetu9Ip8pnaN4K1arNn69ufs5fk9GLrpKtI73-LVJRpQVsVYjS1xi87dEDddfF0xSVTzSQYcp6FtzyiFJzGbZ5LbkKPggFGchDcm5Wh1QqSVpaTNvvOepvFzxaIRca1eZn61bAfvy8fRG0GTgGddn1G7XiFgZCZGL4WWv8Go6iXjid2XAQ&e=f30dc52ea6b3f0fa359c0052b3984e35&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231128_hd_urgent_help_25_777&n=7)**

**Endorsements Rolling in for John Teichert Amid U.S. Senate Bid**

**BALTIMORE, Md**. – The endorsements are rolling in as John Teichert, a retired Air Force Brigadier General, seeks the GOP nomination as a candidate for U.S. Senate. Today, Teichert is excited to announce that he’s received support in his race for Senate from State Senator Johnny Ray Salling from Baltimore County (District 06), Delegate Wayne Hartman from Worcester and Wicomico Counties (District 38C), and Delegate Matt Morgan from St. Mary’s County (District 29A).
Senator Salling shared why he chose to endorse John Teichert, stating, **"It is my honor to endorse my friend and brother in Christ, General John Teichert. I believe that he is our only choice to make a difference in the U.S. Senate."**
Delegate Wayne Hartman was also enthusiastic in his endorsement of Teichert, stating, **"Bold leadership coupled with genuine care and concern - General John Teichert brings the qualities we need in the U.S. Senate. I am confident that General Teichert is the best candidate to bring positive change to our great state."**

[**Grassroots group shifts support from incumbent Rep. Bilirakis, endorses primary challenger James Judge**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=7caf2e1e08&e=00028e5542)
PASCO COUNTY, Fla. – [Community Patriots](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=e47f2b488a&e=00028e5542), a conservative grassroots organization in the Tampa Bay area, endorsed James Judge in the Republican primary for Florida’s 12th Congressional District on Thursday.
The group, which in 2022 endorsed incumbent Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL), decided to shift their support from the incumbent Republican, to the younger, more uniquely qualified opponent.
“James Judge is the right person to represent Republicans in Florida’s 12th Congressional District. He is a strong supporter of law enforcement and has demonstrated he will fight for conservative, Christian values,” said Jeff Hawks, founder of Community Patriots. “While we appreciate Gus’s service, he has been in public office for 25 years. It’s time for someone new. We feel James has his finger on the pulse of the critical issues facing Florida’s 12th Congressional District and the United States today, and that he is better qualified to represent the interests of conservatives in Washington.”
Community Patriots is an active conservative organization throughout the Tampa Bay area with more than 5,000 participants across Pasco, Hillsborough and Pinellas.

clean_body: PASCO COUNTY, Fla. - DADE CITY, Fla. – Community Patriots, a conservative grassroots organization in the Tampa Bay area, endorsed James Judge... | | | | | PASCO COUNTY, Fla. – , a conservative grassroots organization in the Tampa Bay area, endorsed James Judge in the Republican primary for Florida’s 12th Congressional District on Thursday. The group, which in 2022 endorsed incumbent Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL), decided to shift their support from the incumbent Republican, to the younger, more uniquely qualified opponent. “James Judge is the right person to represent Republicans in Florida’s 12th Congressional District. He is a strong supporter of law enforcement and has demonstrated he will fight for conservative, Christian values,” said Jeff Hawks, founder of Community Patriots. “While we appreciate Gus’s service, he has been in public office for 25 years. It’s time for someone new. We feel James has his finger on the pulse of the critical issues facing Florida’s 12th Congressional District and the United States today, and that he is better qualified to represent the interests of conservatives in Washington.” Community Patriots is an active conservative organization throughout the Tampa Bay area with more than 5,000 participants across Pasco, Hillsborough and Pinellas. “Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.” – Dwight D. body:
I’ll always stand up to corruption—whether it’s headline catching (like Santos using campaign funds for botox!), or more covert and common.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34044%2E3422442%2E9BsrEs)
Derek,
Today I voted to expel George Santos. Now, a special election will take place within the next 90 days. [**Can you split a donation right now between my campaign and the NY-03 Special Election Nominee Fund to help Democrats flip Santos’s seat blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231201-1?refcode=EMAN23_1_GSO_20231201_V1_F&refcode2=34044_3422442_9BsrEs&akid=34044%2E3422442%2E9BsrEs)
Expelling George Santos wasn’t a vote I took lightly. But after a thorough Ethics Committee investigation, it was clear George Santos didn’t just lie about his resume—he used running for office as an entire get-rich-quick scheme, blatantly violating campaign finance law and stealing from his supporters.
Now that he’s out, we need to focus on flipping this seat blue. Republicans hold an extremely slim majority in Congress, and flipping this seat _now_ will get us closer to regaining the House majority in November 2024.
**Americans deserve to know their elected officials are working for them.** That’s why I’ll always stand up to corruption—whether it’s headline-catching (like Santos using campaign funds for botox!), or more covert and common—like Members of Congress trading stocks based on information they learn in private briefings.
Can you help us elect a Democrat to George Santos’s old seat and defend against corruption? body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Multiple people running for U.S. Senate and other Congressional seats in
Michigan have said they’ve been offered between $10 and $20 million to run
against me.

As the only Palestinian American in Congress, I will not be bullied. This
attempt to intimidate me will never silence me in saving as many lives as
possible, no matter faith or ethnicity.

I keep thinking about the three Palestinian students in Vermont, whose
mere existence was seen as a threat by someone who decided to open fire.
Hisham, one of the survivors of the shooting, is right when he said: “This
hideous crime did not happen in a vacuum.”

Silencing the voices of Palestinians and all oppressed people is something
that the political establishment has done for decades. We are saying
enough.

Amidst the painful dehumanizing of Palestinians and hate in the United
States towards our communities (especially those speaking out for a
ceasefire), we must be heard and represented in our government. I will not
let extremists who believe in wiping out as many Palestinians as possible
undermine the democratic will of the American people, the vast majority of
whom support a permanent ceasefire.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231201-rt.OwGoCI&refcode=em20231201-32121&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32121%2E1203867%2E-dtGKH ]I will never stop speaking up for Palestinians’ humanity, even when it
makes me a target. As wealthy and powerful people try to take me down, I

I have taken a decisive step in our fight to restore America's greatness | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/45f40c05dd8e/will-you-caucus-for-trump-with-me?e=273c9a71fb)

---
| Dear Peter,

As a proud American and a staunch defender of our constitutional values, I have taken a decisive step in our fight to restore America's greatness.

**Today, I am thrilled to announce my full endorsement of President Donald Trump for the 2024 presidential election.**

My military service taught me the importance of strong, decisive leadership – qualities embodied by President Trump. His presidency was a testament to American strength, prosperity, and security. It's time we rally behind a leader who has proven his commitment to these ideals.

[Join Me in This Crucial Endeavor](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=fb4819cf0d&e=273c9a71fb)

I am calling on you, my fellow patriots, to join me in this endorsement. Your support in the caucuses will be pivotal in solidifying our party's commitment to President Trump's vision for America. Together, we can ensure that our nation is led by a president who truly understands the value of American exceptionalism.

**A Challenge to John Lee**

In light of my endorsement, I extend a challenge to my opponent, Former Democratic Mayor John Lee. His past support for Democratic leaders raises serious questions about his commitment to our Republican values. It's time for John Lee to step up and join us in supporting the true leader of the Republican Party, President Donald Trump.

[**Your Support is Vital**](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=b1b85ac7a4&e=273c9a71fb)

Your voice in this election is more important than ever. B[y endorsing President Trump alongside me](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=38678cc842&e=273c9a71fb), you are taking a stand for the future of our country. I also ask for your financial support to amplify our message across Nevada's 4th Congressional District.

Thank you for standing with me. Together, we will pave the way for a brighter, stronger America.

Sincerely,

LT COL David Flippo
United States Air Force Retired

name: WordPress
subject: Welcome to Our Campaign Family - Let's Make a Difference Together!
body:
I'm thrilled to welcome you to our campaign's growing community! Your decision to join us is not just about supporting a campaign; it's about choosing a neighbor and a veteran committed to fighting for our shared dreams and values in Texas 12th Congressional District.

As we embark on this journey together, our newsletter will be your go-to source for all the latest updates, insights, and ways you can be involved in shaping the future of our community. We are more than a campaign – we are neighbors united by a common goal of bringing positive, tangible change to our district. Expect to hear from me soon with stories, event invites, and opportunities to make your voice heard.

Remember, this is your platform as much as it is mine. I am here to listen, represent, and act on our collective needs. Together, we'll turn our vision for a better tomorrow into reality. Thank you for standing with me, your neighbor, and a veteran who's always ready to serve.

Warm regards,
Sebastian K Gehrig, SrA, USAF (Ret.)
Sebastian Gehrig For Congress

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Friend,

Republicans in Congress are threatening to slash vital social programs like Medicare or Social Security to pay down the nation’s ballooning debt.

But here’s the truth: our nation’s debt is in large part a consequence of tax cuts by Reagan, Bush, and Trump, as well as Bush’s obscene spending on overseas wars. We don’t need a fiscal commission to study our debt, we need to end tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy and make a moonshot investment in American industry.

Tell Congress: Tax the ultra-rich and invest in the American industry. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/end-trump-tax-cuts-petition?contactdata=k6L/qodO73Lu+8PnOa/3ps7X6CjTFBjt4U09kRdJ5inxtNeP+xzcCIKldpsyrpTV08CsEUzMwOwlDvSshbctS0TR3oY8p+U2MWBBINMoRVxlIkA3xkXa62Ztj3Lg5depkr6dTah3Gwbvz6hH6FdjSw==]

Friends,
Earlier this week, I made an appearance on the American Moment podcast.
American Moment is an organization that is seeking to remake the Republican establishment in Washington D.C. They are working to fix the personnel problems that have plagued GOP politics for a very long time, replacing RINOs and globalists that permeate Republican offices in DC with actual conservatives, and are great friends of the State Freedom Caucus Network.
On the podcast with American Moment President Saurabh Sharma, I spoke at length about the problems with red state legislatures, the reasons Republicans in overwhelmingly conservative states govern liberally, and how we're going to fix it by building State Freedom Caucuses.
It was a great discussion about the work the State Freedom Caucus Network is doing.
Watch the full episode here. Sinema’s record on abortion rights has long been mixed. First, she confirmed over 100 of Donald Trump’s judges – including several who were anti-choice extremists. Then, after Trump stacked the Supreme Court with right-wing judges who overturned Roe v. Wade, Sinema joined Republicans in preserving the Senate filibuster instead of joining with Democrats to protect abortion rights.

It’s no wonder groups like NARAL, Emily’s List, and Planned Parenthood rescinded their endorsements of Sinema. Meanwhile, Democratic Rep. Ruben Gallego is staunchly pro-choice, and has promised he’ll work to enshrine abortion rights into federal law.
****
**That’s why we have to do three things in November 2024 to protect the right to choose:**
1. **Pass the Arizona Abortion Access Act ballot initiative**
2. **Defeat Kyrsten Sinema**
3. **Elect Ruben Gallego**
