| | Friend,

We were honored to join [Our Children Have Rights (OCHR)](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=56d6332205&e=cb396c52a2) for an educational town hall, where they laid out the tools their organization offers to help protect the rights of children to have access to their parents by providing education, resources, and support services for successful co-parenting strategies utterly free of charge.

If you couldn't join us, you missed a great conversation! The leaders at OCHR have created an outstanding platform to empower parents struggling with co-parenting plans, child support, and several other issues that affect millions of households in our country.

Luckily, we recorded the town hall! You can watch the entire presentation at the link below to hear about the fantastic resources OCHR provides parents.
---
| [ ](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=a7ec7a6186&e=cb396c52a2)
---
| We'd love for you to join in on the conversation! Children's rights to have access to their parents are not talked about nearly enough today. As we continue to support OCHR, we encourage you to follow along as they work to provide the tools and resources necessary to keep children and their parents close.

You can follow OCHR on social channels here:

Facebook: [Our Children Have Rights](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=a00bf42e59&e=cb396c52a2)
Instagram: [@ourchildrenhaverights](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=d20a2ffd13&e=cb396c52a2)
Twitter/X: [@ourchildrights](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=3280974384&e=cb396c52a2)

If you know someone who may benefit from learning about healthy co-parenting and navigating child custody challenges, we hope you will share this information with them.

To win for America, we must keep children's wellbeing at the forefront of our thinking. OCHR is doing just that. Janelle and I will continue to support their efforts as we move further with our mission of promoting the American Dream.

Sincerely,

Kelvin King
Chairman, Let's Win for America Action

You can follow OCHR on social channels here: Facebook: Instagram: Twitter/X: If you know someone who may benefit from learning about healthy co-parenting and navigating child custody challenges, we hope you will share this information with them. The North Coast is at a tipping point. We have a window of opportunity to disrupt the political class that has ruled over us for a generation. Huffman is on his heels, and I intend to keep him on the defensive. Your support is more vital now than ever.

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKjVwVVqZ2Szif89MdvX6BxKFM5RMjc1X_PNR-r7Kk24Q&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_crucial_moment_for_the_north&n=1)

Dear Friend, Our opponent, Jared Huffman, admits he made “the first mistake of his voting career” by voting in support of Hamas. This was certainly not his first bad vote, but his acknowledgment shows that even he realizes he’s out of touch with the sentiments of the people he represents.
[**The North Coast is at a tipping point. We have a window of opportunity to disrupt the political class that has ruled over us for a generation. Huffman is on his heels, and I intend to keep him on the defensive. Your support is more vital now than ever.**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKjVwVVqZ2Szif89MdvX6BxKFM5RMjc1X_PNR-r7Kk24Q&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_crucial_moment_for_the_north&n=2)
We’re on a mission to raise $10,000 by the December 31 reporting deadline. Every contribution, whether $5 or $50 or $500, signals to our district’s silent majority that we are finally ready to end Jared Huffman’s failed tenure.
Under Huffman’s watch, the quality of life in our district has declined by every metric. Prices are up. Crime is up. Out-migration is up. Education scores are down. New business creation is down. Wages are down.
[**We are calling on 50 dedicated supporters to contribute $200 each to meet our goal. Can you be one of them?**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKjVwVVqZ2Szif89MdvX6BxKFM5RMjc1X_PNR-r7Kk24Q&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_crucial_moment_for_the_north&n=3)
I’m incredibly grateful for all your support thus far, which has helped me secure key endorsements from county GOP committees, setting me up for a victorious March primary. Now it’s time to push harder. Please dig deep, rally your friends, neighbors, and family. [**Contributions are welcome from near and far, even outside the district and the state.**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKjVwVVqZ2Szif89MdvX6BxKFM5RMjc1X_PNR-r7Kk24Q&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_crucial_moment_for_the_north&n=4)
Together, we will forge a new path for the North Coast. Thank you for your continued support. Semper Fidelis,
**Chris Coulombe**
Republican Candidate for California’s 2nd Congressional District

subject: Your Signature Is Needed: Help two vulnerable baby orcas survive their first year on Earth
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Help ensure the survival of two baby orca calves before they die of starvation![_Take action now! >>_ ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2168889?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Friend — _**Southern Resident orcas are clinging to survival and are on the verge of _EXTINCTION._**_ That’s why when two calves were born earlier this year, environmentalists saw it as a hopeful sign that there’s still a chance at restoring the dwindling population of this iconic sea mammal — especially because orca pregnancies end up in _**_MISCARRIAGE_**_ **69% of the time.** Sadly, these two precious calves weren’t born into an easy life, and the _**_mortality rate_**_ for newborn orcas is **as high as 50%.** In fact, scientists won’t assign these two babies names until they survive their first year. But right now, these vulnerable babies are at risk of _**_STARVING TO DEATH_**_ before they even make it through their first year on Earth. Corporate overfishing and bycatch is __**DECIMATING**__ Chinook salmon populations in the Pacific Northwest — **leaving orcas without a primary food source.** _**Friend, will you sit back and do nothing while greedy fishing corporations prevent any chance that these two newborn calves have at living long and healthy lives?**_ [_**Or will you step up right now and be a voice for these endangered orcas before it’s too late to save them? TAKE ACTION NOW: Sign our petition before the deadline at 11:59 P.M. TONIGHT >> **_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2168890?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2168891?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The two newborn calves were born into the same pod as _**Cappuccino and Ripple**_ — two treasured Southern Resident orcas who tragically died within the last few years from what experts believe to be **_human-driven causes_** that are driving the **drastic decline of Chinook salmon.** And unless we demand bold action, it’s all too likely that these two baby orcas will suffer the **_same devastating fate._**
_Too weak and fragile, these young orcas simply won’t survive their first year on this planet without enough Chinook salmon, Friend._ Unless we demand bold government intervention from the National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS), greedy industrial fishing corporations won’t let up — _**because they care more about profits than the fate of these iconic endangered whales.**_
There are __**ONLY 75 Southern Resident orcas**__ remaining in the wild, including the two newborn calves born earlier this year — and these defenseless whales are counting on activists like YOU to speak up for them right away, Friend. [_**We have just a _FEW HOURS LEFT_ to get another 2,901 more activist signatures on our petition telling NMFS to rein in corporate overfishing and bycatch of Chinook salmon that’s threatening to WIPE OUT the very last of these beloved orcas. Can we count on your urgent signature right now?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2168892?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2168891?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Thanks for helping us protect endangered orcas,
Friends of the Earth **

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=873%2E135344%2EB_5Y1A)

Friend,
**BIG news today in the Michigan Senate race: As of this morning, Sandy Pensler announced his candidacy to be the Republican nominee in the U.S. Senate race here in Michigan.** That makes 10 Republicans officially vying for the nomination, of which four are serious competitors.
Michiganders might remember Sandy: he ran for the Republican nomination for Senate in 2018, spent $5 million of his own money on his campaign, and narrowly lost the nomination to John James (who won with 46% of the vote.)
Pensler made his fortune in private equity with Pensler Capital Corp., and has the ability to again spend millions of his own dollars, particularly on early TV ads. In contrast, our campaign is relying on grassroots support from emails like this. It’s quite a difference. [**Can you make a contribution to ensure we have the resources we need to win?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231201-1-tt&t=2&akid=873%2E135344%2EB_5Y1A)
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW →](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231201-1-tt&t=3&akid=873%2E135344%2EB_5Y1A)**
Pensler now joins former Congressman Peter Meijer, former Congressman Mike Rogers, and former Detroit Chief of Police James Craig in the race.
Pensler’s announcement video – which features a healthy dose of scare-tactic messaging to appeal to the extreme elements of GOP – furthers a trend we’ve observed in this primary: It is all about appealing to Trump, and his most fervent supporters.
Since September, we’ve already witnessed Mike Rogers repeatedly selling out his national security credentials to appeal to the anti-law enforcement wing of the Republican party, going so far as to condemn his former colleagues at the FBI. After voting to impeach Trump, Peter Meijer has now completely flip-flopped, claiming he would support Trump's nomination while minimizing the January 6th insurrection. And we’ve seen James Craig go on Steve Bannon’s podcast in the clear hope of currying Trump’s endorsement.
**Beyond just appealing to Trump, Pensler is on record on a whole host of other policies that don’t seem to jive with Michiganders:** he supported the 2017 Trump tax giveaway, cutting taxes for the ultra wealthy like himself, and has staked out an extreme position on abortion. He says he is “100% pro-life,” called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and just this week claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose, “went too far.”
While at first it may appear we have the full range of voices in the Republican primary for Senate, every candidate has proven themselves to be someone who will say and do anything to get elected. Even at the expense of their own dignity.
[**Our campaign is trying to demonstrate a different way. That’s why we’re asking for your support to continue building the kind of campaign we’ll need to WIN. Will you make a donation now? Every contribution in these first 24 hours following this announcement will help us send a clear message about the strength of our campaign.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231201-1-tt&t=4&akid=873%2E135344%2EB_5Y1A)

Michiganders might remember Sandy: he ran for the Republican nomination for Senate in 2018, spent $5 million of his own money on his campaign, and narrowly lost the nomination to John James (who won with 46% of the vote.) Pensler made his fortune in private equity with Pensler Capital Corp., and has the ability to again spend millions of his own dollars, particularly on early TV ads. In contrast, our campaign is relying on grassroots support from emails like this. It’s quite a difference. Pensler now joins former Congressman Peter Meijer, former Congressman Mike Rogers, and former Detroit Chief of Police James Craig in the race. Pensler’s announcement video – which features a healthy dose of scare-tactic messaging to appeal to the extreme elements of GOP – furthers a trend we’ve observed in this primary: It is all about appealing to Trump, and his most fervent supporters. Since September, we’ve already witnessed Mike Rogers repeatedly selling out his national security credentials to appeal to the anti-law enforcement wing of the Republican party, going so far as to condemn his former colleagues at the FBI. After voting to impeach Trump, Peter Meijer has now completely flip-flopped, claiming he would support Trump's nomination while minimizing the January 6th insurrection. And we’ve seen James Craig go on Steve Bannon’s podcast in the clear hope of currying Trump’s endorsement. Beyond just appealing to Trump, Pensler is on record on a whole host of other policies that don’t seem to jive with Michiganders: he supported the 2017 Trump tax giveaway, cutting taxes for the ultra wealthy like himself, and has staked out an extreme position on abortion. He says he is “100% pro-life,” called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and just this week claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose, “went too far.” While at first it may appear we have the full range of voices in the Republican primary for Senate, every candidate has proven themselves to be someone who will say and do anything to get elected. Even at the expense of their own dignity. If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly: | | ** | | | | | | | ** Thanks for your support! name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: UPDATE: Giving Tuesday match unlocked -- thanks to supporters like you.
body:
? ? ? ? ? Dear Peter,

Few of us have forgotten where we were when a violent mob of armed insurrectionists, many of them proudly displaying symbols of white supremacist hate, attacked the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021.

One year later, LCV remembers that day and honors the heroism of Capitol police and others who protected our national seat of elected government from attackers who sought to overturn the presidential election results. We also recommit to one of the day's enduring lessons: that safeguarding our democracy and the right to vote is an urgent priority and must never be taken for granted.

Unfortunately, the anti-democracy attacks didn't stop on January 6 ? opponents of free and fair elections have since adjusted their tactics to focus on state-level policies. At least 19 states have passed laws that restrict the freedom to vote, undermine fair voting districts, and raise the likelihood of future attempts to sabotage fair elections.
?
These attacks on fair elections and voting rights are a national crisis, and they disproportionately seek to suppress and discard votes by people of color and young people who have been historically and systematically excluded from full participation in our democracy.

To ensure that U.S. democracy delivers on its promise to be a government of, by, and for the people ? and to make sure we never experience another January 6th ? our nation has a lot of work to do. This includes passing comprehensive voting rights legislation at the federal level to codify the right to free and fair elections.

As a 50-year old environmental organization with voting and elections at the center of our theory of change, LCV has long understood how essential a free, fair, and equitable democracy is to protecting people and the planet. In the last two decades, LCV and our sister organization, LCV Education Fund, have become leaders among our national peers in democracy and civic engagement, while our 30+ state affiliates have become valued partners in efforts to strengthen voting rights at the state and local levels.

Together, we've helped register 1.5 million voters, won ballot measures on redistricting and automatic voter registration, and worked with election officials to expand voting site access. Our Democracy for All https://links.messages.lcv. program already comprises one of the largest and most dynamic civic engagement efforts in the nation and the largest, most impactful program within the environmental movement.

Yet given the stakes, we need to do much more. That is why this past year, LCV dramatically expanded our democracy work and will continue to do so in 2022 and beyond.
?
For the first time, LCV has also elevated strengthening democracy to a standalone goal in our four-year strategic plan ? and a priority on par with addressing climate change. Our plan through 2024 https://links.messages.lcv. will advance pro-democracy reforms, defend against voter suppression, and counter misinformation. We are developing a coordinated 10-year plan with our 30+ state affiliates to pursue this work at all levels by advancing policies that can help close the racial participation gap between communities of color and white voters.

The stakes of this crisis couldn't be higher for our freedom, our future, and the health and safety of our communities. Thank you for being part of this work and for believing that our democracy, like our Earth, is worth protecting.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President, League of Conservation Voters

People of different races, places, party affiliations, and backgrounds will be joining peacefully to say: In the United States, the voters decide the outcome of elections. At the top of our to-do list is a [package](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=859cb1cfc98c4e30ac1f9072dfe6cd85&_e=aKVZF14eUxH5P7mMS-3RDOROc2HY61chS3pxVnUKt8WGiGMYLyVg3UJkYT4GrkW0k2t92AmvESOPK906vLm-UbBCNOaocfoYE8eEJF68juxGe6TZ94aH8bBoTLG3-yYxDNiuVAy0ENXxBYdVg9UZ9wlxDjk2KejH9RPrUpzNK-HguNu4RKxgK8mPRyuSPRM5hCkFMSVBEcLK_V4mWUe9nwVrhwTZb8ki5buSG-A5hCneAROowm3icGm4zIZfskwUCcVpDEGgZjB_rTxtQkVBsw%3D%3D) for BILLIONS in aid to folks all over the dadgum world, admittedly many of whom do need our help. But I won’t vote to send tens of billions of dollars to a corrupt country like Ukraine when we’re nearly [$34 trillion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=859cb1cfc98c4e30ac1f9072dfe6cd85&_e=aKVZF14eUxH5P7mMS-3RDGZIxGbGNkNBWblwsRCFQ7VoIt7tDDIoAZOGsJRn9eSy3oFVZ7XA7hBBO-C2k0hgiX8c8AzDdomowRL9hnkBXY6FkSvSmBVuRrB-zI27FpxajsHT51qQuVtvcpkpKDSOHEbCebYOPZqK-MbHUi4ALsRpMiruigQbqbqwHS-PbKX7yPbXQtNGFo_sAY82dFFarI6vn4c1CG7d8_bsidZ7ozEZcjBgBWyqcK22fn9nCS0ry4ZoQIdp-gfp7ISYqd5AQyPGgu1lwgr09elcUoNdu8s%3D) in the hole, and we’ve got a full-fledged crisis unfolding at [our own border](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=859cb1cfc98c4e30ac1f9072dfe6cd85&_e=aKVZF14eUxH5P7mMS-3RDCIXWCIsdfUHfg6Emb3cntydKlqz5V5YjSH-wP6gXzZDCnQlYJbJcjJMHhe3mONHfGSPSNesTK-NETO0I8MYn4x-b9Y5U_XZYe6Ojx5eDWGdgyYo7Fwf2lAcZKzXKsOsb2ICeJn7h5O9-UsgFrfOmvLdS1tUX8vrmVSbFRE_sSl1TqAjqvthcgFFn7VPrMb_ABg1I7KKcUjqeqa-UE1as3Ktk8nvEmJHGq0mHXAQvPKdb1DkUHpyI70YlL123eaNN7nwPZE01roa-kOm9qzNshsH1c2nWDInS0Yb1-uaYv5E). This has been a long time coming, and as the lawlessness at our southern border rages on, it's plain as day that we're dealing with a real-deal emergency. We've got a record number of people streaming in through Biden’s wide-open gates, and word from our Border Patrol agents in the thick of it is that a good many are on the [terror watch list.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=859cb1cfc98c4e30ac1f9072dfe6cd85&_e=aKVZF14eUxH5P7mMS-3RDCIXWCIsdfUHfg6Emb3cntxal7RIBUPc_617IENZe7slDX8IQYa35Z_iyvTUkK4Nv7uscK7_1ymXJ2M1ghR153LY9b9WPnIE7Mkow4Ki97CTExh6onVd9qBepRi-MQC2GiY94FxgHoI7-OZqYSsysXbgGxWu3sF-ZyAWENTZbxwVWjFSqI3ZMQZ31FPT4Skzyfv2rv0xD0D0P7AgI5YfqCK0iH6eXydozu5M8g7IdP-M1q5Dtisfey3p4xGNFKntFqSYu7Ta1rIXjYXjW3j5fAKjWxi0s6Y85Q65DXqZ6CSJ) Where in the world are our priorities, folks? Yet here we are throwing more money at Ukraine after we’ve already sent them a whopping [114 billion _unchecked_ dollars](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=859cb1cfc98c4e30ac1f9072dfe6cd85&_e=aKVZF14eUxH5P7mMS-3RDCIXWCIsdfUHfg6Emb3cnty5TQjGo_xfVG9a6slV2NBhZJydkJ0swIgAO3LZiM3gKq7j6it5tSD2M8DX9cHa3VphVTn7v-pkUVJ-OJCh1yIvYeJt7-Kdp0VMKPEhG3Ky6LKWTA5EYsyjnNvwVMX7VHPcgQ6RSZbP1rESjBujGZJcneMPG-6BuHHyRuhyTVKHT6h_yA7MvXny3yOLzS_6FnY2e1pcfdLD8i7Am-4O989tv-D-NX5HodoAyDGRLtrUL244qT5jlRt0L8zXoRAYMm2qhJPFU-AUVL5zq_VjavsU). There are no receipts for this Ukraine funding, and this isn’t a game of Monopoly—it’s your hard-earned money at stake. Our friends and allies in Israel desperately need us right now. Our border deserves immediate intervention. _These_ items are worthy of our spending, and even though I’m going to sound like a broken record here, they’re good enough to be separate bills. Once again, I'm downright fed up with Democrats hitching these matters to [Ukraine](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=859cb1cfc98c4e30ac1f9072dfe6cd85&_e=aKVZF14eUxH5P7mMS-3RDA3KApaGdl5RwrPNbDsx3NYi07sSj6nKiHUJSIIyMu6y-S5qQn48MORuhmlrhsQAOGaGkKANwMtmqDmTLfnOk5YvFw2zfmQ5qtCBRaqa8Y-4VbXwg4QJlEE8SOlypC08s0xnzkiU4DAOT0xhvvxhyTsnEMznKDWMgw6uFAxRlxqIODHsu3qO7pnnT_KZZKRVuNXNos5hnOipVZWV7uNn0aRmKSV7OXDi1W1omBEmIc4WNawqR4wJu0ph7K-u423xadcSx4ps-Y-3S6Fc9FcUrCoB9oDZFtOd4W93cjt7P9r_), just to keep the wheels of corruption turning. All of you back home have made your stance crystal clear: the Ukraine gravy train must stop immediately, and I want to honor you by putting my foot down. We’ve got our hands full as we try to wrangle all this next week, but here’s to hoping we come out on the other side with a constructive plan and some fiscal responsibility.

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | | | | No More Blank Checks ⛔ | | Congress has a whole lot to tackle before we break for the holidays. At the top of our to-do list is a for BILLIONS in aid to folks all over the dadgum world, admittedly many of whom do need our help. But I won’t vote to send tens of billions of dollars to a corrupt country like Ukraine when we’re nearly in the hole, and we’ve got a full-fledged crisis unfolding at . This has been a long time coming, and as the lawlessness at our southern border rages on, it's plain as day that we're dealing with a real-deal emergency. We've got a record number of people streaming in through Biden’s wide-open gates, and word from our Border Patrol agents in the thick of it is that a good many are on the Where in the world are our priorities, folks? I still remember when President Trump was told the to build a wall would break us. Yet here we are throwing more money at Ukraine after we’ve already sent them a whopping . There are no receipts for this Ukraine funding, and this isn’t a game of Monopoly—it’s your hard-earned money at stake. Our friends and allies in Israel desperately need us right now. Our border deserves immediate intervention. These items are worthy of our spending, and even though I’m going to sound like a broken record here, they’re good enough to be separate bills. Once again, I'm downright fed up with Democrats hitching these matters to , just to keep the wheels of corruption turning. All of you back home have made your stance crystal clear: the Ukraine gravy train must stop immediately, and I want to honor you by putting my foot down. We’ve got our hands full as we try to wrangle all this next week, but here’s to hoping we come out on the other side with a constructive plan and some fiscal responsibility. | | | | | Christmas Comes To East Tennessee 🧡 | | It isn’t Christmas in Knoxville until the downtown tree is decked out and lit up! | | My beloved community – I just wanted to take a moment to thank you for standing with me in this race. We have a tough fight ahead of us, but I've won tough fights before. And with your support, **WE** can do it again. [**But here’s the bad news – last week, when we closed the books on our end of month fundraising goal, we still hadn’t met our digital goal.**](http://numerolinks.lateefahsimon.com/f/a/1AfWshsCVKFjg6kXiVaaAg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnTPKxP0Q7aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP3JlZmNvZGU9RGVjMDEtMjNXA3NwY0IKZWq1bWplMhD661IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~) We need to make up some ground (to that end, I’ll tell you about our BRAND NEW fundraising goal in just a second). Now, don’t get me wrong, I am still incredibly proud of what we raised. But the next month will be critical for this campaign and that’s because at the end of December, we will close the books on our FINAL FEC fundraising quarter of the year. That's why I'm turning to you, our supporters, to help us bridge the gap. I’ve talked to my campaign team about what we need to get done in order to make up some of the ground we lost and together we came up with a new ONE WEEK GOAL: [**$1,375.**](http://numerolinks.lateefahsimon.com/f/a/1AfWshsCVKFjg6kXiVaaAg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnTPKxP0Q7aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP3JlZmNvZGU9RGVjMDEtMjNXA3NwY0IKZWq1bWplMhD661IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~) [**$1,375 in one week.**](http://numerolinks.lateefahsimon.com/f/a/1AfWshsCVKFjg6kXiVaaAg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnTPKxP0Q7aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP3JlZmNvZGU9RGVjMDEtMjNXA3NwY0IKZWq1bWplMhD661IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~) That is what it’s going to take to get us back on track and it’s a number I know this team can reach because we have done it before.
